statements.status_notes: Deserialization vulnerability in logback-core 1.5.32 HardenedObjectInputStream. Fixed in 1.5.33. Waiting for upstream SonarQube to upgrade logback-core. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in compiled application JARs and cannot be patched via JAR replacement.

Deserialization vulnerability in logback-core 1.5.32 HardenedObjectInputStream. Fixed in 1.5.33. Waiting for upstream SonarQube to upgrade logback-core. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in compiled application JARs and cannot be patched via JAR replacement.

logback is the non-default, optional logging backend for the operator; the image uses log4j2 by default. The fix requires logback 1.5.33+, which requires slf4j 2.x while Flink 1.20 bundles slf4j 1.7.x and the log4j-slf4j (1.7) binding. Adopting the fix means migrating the entire logging stack (slf4j 2.x plus a log4j-slf4j2 binding swap), which would change the default log4j2 path; assessment of that migration is pending. Severity is LOW (CVSS 1.2) and exploitation requires local access with heavily restricted deserialization.

logback-core 1.5.32 is a transitive dependency from upstream DataHub 1.6.0. CVE-2026-9828 affects versions through 1.5.32 inclusive with no fix version published. The vulnerability requires attacker influence over serialized data sent to SimpleSocketServer or SimpleSSLSocketServer; datahub-upgrade does not expose these logback server components. Monitoring for patched release.

Fixed in logback-core 1.5.25. The 1.5.x line requires Java 11+; the 1.3.x line is the last Java-8-compatible series and is no longer receiving backports. Stargate is currently pinned to Java 8 by its maven-enforcer rule. Will bump to 1.5.x when stargate supports Java 11+. Severity is LOW (CVSS 1.8); exploit requires local high-privilege access.
